name: A Token of Vengeance
summary: An ally asks you to find the Twilight’s Hammer hiding in a cave network near Krol'dok Stronghold. Their attacks have hurt your allies and threaten the land.

sections.title: The Hidden Caves
sections.body: The scouts have reported Twilight’s Hammer cultists moving beneath the rugged ground near Krol'dok Stronghold. Your ally says their attacks have caused great pain to your allies and that the cultists are claiming the land. You are asked to find their hiding place and bring back fifteen cultist ears as a message of vengeance.

faq.answer: You are looking for Twilight’s Hammer cultists hiding in a cave network near Krol'dok Stronghold.

faq.q: Why are the cultists being hunted?
faq.answer: The giver says the cultists have inflicted pain on their allies and are claiming the land.
Scouts reported cultist movement beneath the rugged terrain, in a hidden cave network to the north.

faq.q: What am I asked to bring back?
faq.answer: You are asked to collect fifteen Cultist Ears from the Twilight’s Hammer at Krol'dok Stronghold.

attribution: In-game quest text: A Token of Vengeance
